g.text: The same sensor can leave different uncertainty
Conditional squared-error risk = posterior variance; all curves follow the lecture's uniform model.
A narrower feasible interval leaves less variance.
Density panels share one vertical scale; both integrate to 1.
Exact model curves, not measurements. Endpoint variance values on the left are limiting values.
